chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"The elderly man and the elderly woman: one hundred lashes and stoning; and the virgin man and the virgin woman: one hundred lashes and banishment for one year."

key_terms.جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ: one hundred lashes, a prescribed corporal punishment
key_terms.ٱلرَّجْمُ: stoning, a legal penalty mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.ٱلشَّيْخَةُ: the elderly woman, mentioned here as a legal category in the ruling
key_terms.ٱلشَّيْخُ: the elderly man, mentioned here as a legal category in the ruling
key_terms.ٱلْبِكْرَةُ: the virgin woman, meaning one not previously married/consummated in this legal context
key_terms.ٱلْبِكْرُ: the virgin man, meaning one not previously married/consummated in this legal context

ai.seo_question: What punishment does this hadith assign for zina for elderly and unmarried offenders?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the hadd of zina, distinguishing between categories of offenders and the penalties applied to each. It is significant in Shiʿi fiqh discussions on judicial rulings and the legal treatment of illicit sexual relations.
